captions.detailed: A 3D-rendered model of a customizable box lid, shown from an inverted perspective. It features a shallow rectangular tray with rounded outer edges and a thin perimeter lip. Along one long edge, there are two small hinge pins protruding outwards, while the opposite long edge features a central locking mechanism consisting of a conical base topped by a small vertical cylinder.
captions.instruction: Design a customizable, 3D-printable lid for a locking pencil box. The lid should have rounded outer corners, a shallow inner lip, integrated hinge pins along one long edge, and a central locking cylinder on a conical base along the opposite edge, with parameters for length, depth, and height.
captions.factory: The lid is constructed using a difference operation on nested rounded cubes to create the hollow tray shape. The hinge pins are created using cylinders rotated and translated along one edge. The lock mechanism is built by unioning a cone (using cylinder with different r1 and r2) and a smaller vertical cylinder, positioned centrally on the opposite wall of the lid.
